tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches print products by keyword (e.g. "biglietti da visita", "adesivi trasparenti", "roll up"). The catalog is in Italian and Italian words work best; plurals, some typos and the most common English words (stickers, business cards, flyers) are understood, words that match no product are dropped,

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Retrieves up to 20 products by product or material id (as returned by search_catalog). Each material reports in inputs the requested id that produced it. A product id returns only the default material of its product page: the others are in options, each with its own id to request here or from get_pr

findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
